pattern_decision_tree: Pattern Discovery → Existing Similar? YES → ENHANCE existing | NO → Novel Approach? YES → CREATE new | NO → Document in fix only
Enhancement criteria: Similar use case, valuable feedback, usage frequency ≥3, maintains coherence
Creation criteria: Novel approach, reusable ≥3 scenarios, sufficient complexity, clear benefits
pattern_documentation: Enhance existing patterns with implementation feedback using standardized format
Create new patterns following template with status, category, difficulty, examples
Update pattern cross-references and usage frequency tracking systematically
Validate pattern documentation completeness and integration with existing patterns
consolidation_compliance: Search existing patterns before creating new ones to prevent duplication
Enhance existing patterns rather than creating duplicates when appropriate
Update bidirectional references and maintain usage tracking accuracy
Apply difficulty classification and maintain reference integrity
